title: Private Widget Package Metadata (widget-metadata.json inside the import zip)
description: Shape read by the Portal admin 'Add private widget' dialog when importing a zip. This is NOT the same shape as the repo-level widget-metadata.json (see widget-metadata.schema.json). Produced by `portal-widget pack`.

tagName.description: Custom-element tag. Must match customElements.define() in the bundles.

name.description: Display name per language. An 'en' entry is required by the Portal dialog. Max 100 characters each.

description.description: HTML description per language. An 'en' entry is required. Max 4000 characters each.

angularVersion.description: 0 for non-Angular widgets. The Portal loads the light bundle only when this equals its own Angular major.

authenticated.description: true = only authenticated users may see the widget.

changes.description: Customer-facing release notes per language (HTML). An 'en' entry is required.

fileFullName.description: Zip entry name of the full bundle. Convention: <tag>-<version>-full.js

fileLightName.description: Zip entry name of the light bundle. Convention: <tag>-<version>-light.js

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, pt-BR
